about: Hanover is a town in Grey County, Ontario, on the Saugeen River inland from Lake Huron—not Hanover Rural Municipality in Manitoba. A manufacturing and farm-service centre, it has a downtown on the river and a regional hospital serving southern Grey-Bruce. About 8,000 people live in Hanover, Ontario.
